name: nexus_wars
title: Nexus Wars
description: Conquer planets orbiting a sun in continuous space. Launching fleets costs energy, so old Planet/Obit bots are not portable.

episodeSteps.description: Maximum number of steps per match. Match terminates at step >= episodeSteps - 1 (every step resolves).

actTimeout.description: Maximum wall time (seconds) a bot may take per turn. Enforced by the sandbox watchdog.

runTimeout.description: Maximum wall time (seconds) for the whole match.

shipSpeed.description: Maximum fleet speed per turn. Speed scales with fleet size: 1 ship moves at 1/turn, larger fleets approach this max.

energyCap.description: Maximum energy a planet can store.

energyRegen.description: Energy regenerated by an owned planet each turn (capped at energyCap).

launchEnergyCost.description: Flat energy cost deducted from a planet when it launches a fleet. Insufficient energy => launch rejected.

seed.description: Optional input seed for deterministic map generation. Scrubbed from configuration before the first agent.act() and stored on env.info['seed'] for the replay.

reward.description: Final match outcome: 1 for the winner, -1 for the loser, 0 for a draw.

planets.description: List of planets: [id, owner, x, y, radius, ships, production, energy, energyCap, energyRegen]. owner -1 = neutral.

fleets.description: List of active fleets: [id, owner, x, y, angle, from_planet_id, ships, launchedStep].

angular_velocity.description: Rotation speed of orbiting planets in radians per turn.

initial_planets.description: Initial planet positions at game start (same schema as planets). Used to compute orbital motion.

action.description: List of launch commands. Each is [from_planet_id, direction_angle_radians, num_ships]. A launch requires the planet to have >= num_ships AND >= launchEnergyCost energy, else it is rejected.
